note: Bay County MI has no public queryable zoning polygon service found. Bay City's zoning is viewable only in the Fetch GIS viewer (app.fetchgis.com/bay), a vendor viewer with no ArcGIS REST endpoints discoverable; Bay City and township zoning maps are published as PDFs. The Bay County ArcGIS experience 'Planning and Zoning' (orgId QB0VWfqR9MD4lF0F) links a Zoning FeatureServer, but that service is Bay County, Florida, not Michigan, so it was not used.
